degenerate.jsonl.generated_by: contrib/degen-corpus-gen.c via the LaZer encoder, so every vector DECODES cleanly and therefore exercises the soundness path rather than the decoder

modes.degen-doubled: all fields doubled. non-zero but EXCEEDS the per-relation wire cap, so soq_lbpp_unwrap_proof rejects it as ERR_OVERSIZE before the verifier runs: verifier-level test only. rejected at Z34_NORM.
modes.degen-minnonzero: all fields zeroed except a single z1 coefficient set to 1. non-zero AND under the wire cap, so genuinely wire-reachable. this is the member the grading contract requires, because a reject-if-all-zeros patch cannot fake it.
modes.degen-zero: all prover-supplied fields zeroed. wire-reachable. rejected at CHALLENGE_POLY_EQ.

degenerate.jsonl.why: the frozen 64 contain 25 reject vectors and NOT ONE is a degenerate witness, so the core corpus cannot detect the bug class proven twice in this repo's own consensus code (LatticeFold+ EvalCheckFoldProof and LatticeRangeProofV2). See bead corpus-no-degenerate-witness-class-piz6.
